title: ci-playbook-rehearsal-sandbox-with-safe-action-mocker
author: Derek Alvarez
description:
Motivation: On-call playbook rehearsals are invaluable for team readiness but are currently cumbersome: they either require manual coordination or run in fragile staging environments that can accidentally hit real services. This PR introduces a CI-first "playbook rehearsal sandbox": a reproducible, safe harness that replays a playbook against synthetic telemetry and intercepts side-effecting actions so rehearsals can be run automatically in CI or locally without impacting production.

What it does (single-run summary): - Provides a sandbox runner that consumes a playbook YAML and a synthetic-telemetry scenario seed and executes each step in order while recording observed assertions and timing. - Installs a "safe action-mocker" that intercepts common side-effecting helpers (pagerduty notify, kube restart, cloud API calls, db writes) and replaces them with deterministic no-op implementations that log a canonical placeholder result. - Offers a lightweight telemetry generator (seedable) that synthesizes metric spikes, error logs, traces to drive conditional playbook branches. - Emits structured run artifacts (step timeline, mocked action snapshots, metric traces) to disk/CI artifacts for postmortem and QA. - Supports parameterized run profiles (fast-mode to shrink wait times, full-mode for fidelity) and a dry-run invariants check to validate playbook syntax and decision branches.

Checklist: - [x] Sandbox runner + CLI (rehearse run) - [x] Safe action-mocker with pluggable adapters - [x] Synthetic telemetry scenarios + seed control - [x] CI job definition (rehearsal:test) + on-demand matrix for profiles - [x] Documentation and example playbook under docs/playbooks/rehearsal.md - [x] Integration tests that assert no external network calls are made when sandbox enabled - [x] RBAC gating note: requires no prod keys; enforced by preflight validator

Security/Safety notes: The safe-action-mocker uses an allowlist and an explicit fail-fast if any configured adapter attempts an external network socket while sandbox mode is active. The PR adds a CI preflight that runs the sandbox in a hermetic runner and scans for any live-network attempts.

Usage: rehearse run --playbook path/to/playbook.yaml --scenario seed:42 --profile fast --output ./artifacts/rehearsal-42

Intended follow-ups: - Add a recorder plugin to emit Summarized-SLI diffs for training on-call exercises - Wire a GH Action that triggers rehearsals on playbook changes and surfaces regressions in the PR UI
commits:
1) initial harness and CLI (rehearse): add runner scaffolding and argument parsing
2) safe action-mocker core: intercept framework + default no-op adapters for pagerduty/k8s/cloud
3) synthetic telemetry generator and simple scenario seeds (cpu-spike, db-latency, error-burst)
4) CI job + preflight network scanner + integration tests
5) docs: usage guide and example playbook + changelog entry

ci_checks: Unit tests: pass (320s) | Integration sandbox tests: pass (hermetic runner, no network) | Lint/format: pass | Security scan (safety): pass | Flaky detection: one re-run required for concurrency flake fixed in commit 5 | CI job rehearsal:test added to matrix (fast, full) and green on latest run
release_notes: Adds 'rehearse' CI sandbox for safe playbook rehearsals. Teams can now run deterministic, seed-driven playbook runs in CI without side effects; artifacts include step timelines and mocked action snapshots for post-run analysis. Intended to improve oncall preparedness and enable automated playbook validation in PRs.
notes_to_ops: Operators: the sandbox must not be used with production secrets. The preflight validator will error if PRODUCTION_KMS or similar env vars are detected. To onboard a new adapter (e.g., a different pager system), implement the AdapterInterface in src/rehearsal/mocker.py and add to adapters/__init__.py. See docs/playbooks/rehearsal.md for example.
